title: hotfix: SLO enforcement + circuit breaker + regional failover load-shedding (post-incident)
author: Aisha Patel
description: Post-incident hotfix to improve SLO enforcement and graceful degradation during regional latency spikes. Motivation: during a recent partial regional outage we observed cascading queuing and large request latencies when the rollout fallback hit an overloaded GPU pool in us-west-2. This PR introduces a multi-tiered approach: 1) stricter SLO enforcement in the API gateway with fast-path circuit breakers to fail fast and surface errors to clients; 2) a probabilistic load-shedding policy at the router level that reduces tail latency under overload by shedding low-priority requests; 3) regional failover tweaks so requests route to the next-compatible region earlier when a region's success rate drops below SLO thresholds; 4) additional metrics and traces to make decision boundaries observable in CloudWatch and the Console. Checklist: - [x] Implement circuit-breaker state machine and thresholds - [x] Add probabilistic load-shed policy and per-route opt-outs - [x] Add routing policy changes for earlier regional failover - [x] Unit + integration tests for circuit breaker and shedder - [x] Add metrics (circuit_breaker_state, shed_rate, region_failover_count) - [x] Add release notes and postmortem link Related: ENG-4012 (primary work item), SUP-887 (support ticket that surfaced the customer impact). Rollout plan: immediate canary in staging, 10% traffic ramp to prod with alerting enabled, then full rollout if metrics look stable. This is a hotfix: we kept changes narrowly scoped to routing and serving layers to reduce blast radius. Implementation notes: - Circuit breaker is a token-bucket-style breaker that counts recent failures + latency percentiles and transitions through CLOSED->OPEN->HALF_OPEN. - Load shedding is a randomized early-drop on lower-priority routes (embeddings background, telemetry ingestion) and uses adaptive rate inferred from queue depth. - Regional failover uses a moving-window success-rate evaluation; when a region falls below the configured SLO success_rate threshold for >= 30s, routing will prefer next region and will only consider returning to the original region after 5 minutes and a success-rate recovery. See inline comments for tuning constants. Migration: config defaults preserved; new behavior controlled by feature flag rollout.enable_slo_early_failover (off by default in staging).
